description: Land Acquisition - Meethatamulla, Kolonnawa D/S Division, Colombo District - Amendment to the Ex. Gaz. No. 2282/17 of 30.05.2022
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed notices for acquiring specific land parcels (including lot numbers, descriptions, extents, and claimant information) for public purposes. The content focuses on property descriptions, acquisition procedures, and compensation claims, which squarely fits the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
